Class ToyAimEnv

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.sim.ToyAimEnv
public final class ToyAimEnv extends Object
A stand-in for the game that needs no Minecraft: a camera that can turn, and a target that sits somewhere around it and occasionally hops. It produces the same mask statistics and ground truth the mod does, which is enough to prove the learner end to end. It does not model movement or combat.

Like the real game it can show the agent an image that is one tick old, i.e. taken before the agent's latest camera move.

    • ToyAimEnv

      public ToyAimEnv(StageSpec stage, int stageIndex, long seed, int frameDelay, boolean useSightTracker, float aimResponse)
      Parameters:
      frameDelay - 0 shows the current view; 1 shows the view from before the latest action
      useSightTracker - false feeds the raw statistics with no camera compensation and no memory, to measure what those two are worth
      aimResponse - see AimMotor; 1 turns the camera by exactly what the action says
